title: Hedgehog reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- hedgehog body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="30" ry="20" fill="#C2703E"/>
  <!-- spiky back -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="28" ry="16" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <polygon points="28,58 24,44 34,52" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <polygon points="38,52 36,36 46,48" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <polygon points="50,50 52,34 58,48" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <polygon points="62,52 66,38 70,50" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <polygon points="72,56 78,46 76,58" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <polygon points="24,62 16,54 28,60" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <polygon points="74,62 84,56 76,64" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <!-- belly / front -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="22" ry="14" fill="#E8B87A"/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#F0C890"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="64" r="2.5" fill="#2A1A0A"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="64" r="2.5" fill="#2A1A0A"/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="63" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="63" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="69" r="2.5" fill="#3A2A1A"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M46,72 Q50,75 54,72" stroke="#3A2A1A" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="68" r="2" fill="#E88C8C" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="68" r="2" fill="#E88C8C" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="56" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#C2703E"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="56" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#C2703E"/>
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="56" rx="2.5" ry="3.5" fill="#E8B87A"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="56" rx="2.5" ry="3.5" fill="#E8B87A"/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x="34" y="78" width="32" height="18" rx="2" fill="#4A9BD9"/>
  <rect x="34" y="78" width="15" height="18" rx="2" fill="#5BB0E8"/>
  <line x1="49" y1="78" x2="49" y2="96" stroke="#2E6FA3" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- book pages -->
  <rect x="35" y="80" width="13" height="14" rx="1" fill="#FFF8E8"/>
  <rect x="50" y="80" width="13" height="14" rx="1" fill="#FFF8E8"/>
  <!-- page lines -->
  <line x1="37" y1="83" x2="46" y2="83" stroke="#D4C8B0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="37" y1="86" x2="46" y2="86" stroke="#D4C8B0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="37" y1="89" x2="46" y2="89" stroke="#D4C8B0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="52" y1="83" x2="61" y2="83" stroke="#D4C8B0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="52" y1="86" x2="61" y2="86" stroke="#D4C8B0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="52" y1="89" x2="61" y2="89" stroke="#D4C8B0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <!-- paws on book -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="82" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#F0C890"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="82" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#F0C890"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="92" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#E8B87A"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="92" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#E8B87A"/>
</svg>
